member.name: T:LoadGenerator.SyntheticDataGenerator
member.summary: Produces a realistic-looking topology (origins, endpoints, routes, mappings) and a body of synthetic request-history rows spread across the configured window. Traffic is shaped by time-of-day and weekday patterns, per-endpoint weighting, and randomized status codes and latencies so the dashboard renders like a live deployment rather than uniform noise.
